daily_report_markdown:
### Headline summary
- Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge announced an AI-assisted proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, a claim certified by the Lean and Mathlib communities. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-21/anthropic-researcher-claims-to-solve-riemann-problem-with-claude), [Latent Space](https://latent.space/p/ainews-riemann-hypothesis-proved-twice-independently/))
- Anthropic completed a record-breaking IPO, but its shares dropped 8.5% in the second trading session as the broader AI sector entered a bear market. ([Last Week in AI](https://lastweekin.ai/p/last-week-in-ai-348-ipo-correction), [NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/21/business/anthropic-stock-wall-street-silicon-valley.html))
- Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia's CEO, with Colette Kress serving as interim CEO amid reports of his management style and market value fluctuations. ([NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/technology/nvidia-jensen-huang-affair-colette-kress.html), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/jensen-huang-nvidia-ceo-comeback-advice-allies-2026-11))

### Levent Alpöge's AI-assisted proof of the Riemann Hypothesis
Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge announced he used Claude to prove the Riemann Hypothesis, a claim subsequently certified by the Lean and Mathlib communities and verified by independent groups. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-21/anthropic-researcher-claims-to-solve-riemann-problem-with-claude), [Latent Space](https://latent.space/p/ainews-riemann-hypothesis-proved-twice-independently/), [News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-11-anthropic-worker-holy-grail-math.html), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/hours-after-anthropic-claims-a-claude-proof-of-the-riemann-hypothesis-stanford-releases-an-all-human-competing-draft/))

### Anthropic IPO and subsequent stock market correction
Anthropic completed a record-breaking IPO, but its shares dropped 8.5% in the second trading session as the broader AI sector and Nasdaq 100 entered a bear market amid investor concerns. ([Last Week in AI](https://lastweekin.ai/p/last-week-in-ai-348-ipo-correction), [NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/21/business/anthropic-stock-wall-street-silicon-valley.html), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/us-technology-stocks-suffer-their-worst-weekly-loss-since-the-pandemic-as-ai-doubts-pile-up/), [News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-11-ai-honeymoon-wall-street.html))

### Jensen Huang's resignation and Nvidia leadership transition
Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia's CEO, with Colette Kress serving as interim CEO, amid reports of his management style and market value fluctuations. ([NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/18/technology/nvidia-jensen-huang-affair-colette-kress.html), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/jensen-huang-nvidia-ceo-comeback-advice-allies-2026-11), [NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/20/technology/jensen-huang-nvidia-culture.html), [TechSpot](https://www.techspot.com/news/114651-jensen-huang-berated-nvidia-employees-decades-nyt-report.html))

### Nvidia faces regulatory scrutiny and market uncertainty
Nvidia is under a California probe for potential criminal violations regarding chip sales to China, while industry insiders report new US export rules affect a broader range of chips, and investors debate the company's future. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261121/p2#a261121p2), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/can-jensen-return), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-21/california-nvidia-probe-covers-potential-criminal-law-violations), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/21/a-tale-of-two-nvidias/))

### Amazon nearing $7.5B acquisition of AI startup Decart
Multiple reports indicate that Amazon is in advanced talks to acquire the Israeli AI startup Decart for approximately $7.5 billion. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261121/p8#a261121p8), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/amazon-nearing-7-5-billion-purchase-decart), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.ft.com/content/dc7749dc-0f40-44a6-80bc-7f747d383616))

### Oracle secures funding for OpenAI infrastructure contract
Oracle announced on November 20, 2026, that it has secured all necessary funding to fulfill its infrastructure contract with OpenAI, stating that further private discussions with vendors are additional options. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261120/p43#a261120p43), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/oracle-says-funding-for-openai-infrastructure-contract-is-secured/), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/oracle-says-completed-funding-fulfil-openai-deal))

### UN talks on autonomous weapons regulation fail
International negotiations in Geneva to establish rules for autonomous weapons systems collapsed after around 100 countries backed binding regulations but faced opposition from the United States, Russia, and Israel. ([International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/un-talks-autonomous-weapons-further-negotiations-3810048), [Artificial intelligence (AI)](https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/21/international-talks-control-ai-autonomous-weapons-collapse), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1039554/un-regulations-killer-robots))

### AI-assisted proof of Navier-Stokes blowup published
NYU's Tristan Buckmaster and Anthropic's Levent Alpöge published an AI-aided proof of Navier-Stokes blowup, claiming it closes a loophole in a previous OpenAI solution. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261121/p4#a261121p4), [Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/ai-just-solved-the-real-navier-stokes-problem/))
